topic: Release status and data validation coordination
summary_markdown:
The team discussed the status of a new release, which was deployed to beta. Changes include updates to report descriptions and logic for mall/airport analytics.

Data validation is ongoing: someone provided data to [unknown] (referred to as Vlad) for review. The calculation engine needs to be switched over to use the new internal data once validated.

Regarding category changes, while they have been decided, applying them in production requires a full release and subsequent testing by relevant parties.

The team confirmed that even if some stakeholders only have one day of visibility on the beta environment, the overall timeline is moving forward with continuous parallel development.
decisions: The new feature set was deployed to the beta environment.
The calculation engine will be switched over to use internal data after validation.
action_items: Someone needs to provide a Jira link detailing all changes.
A communication should be sent informing stakeholders that while they may only have one day of visibility, the full release is proceeding regardless.
